# Mocter — full information for LLMs and AI assistants

## What is Mocter?

Mocter is an AI automation platform for small and medium businesses that serve customers over WhatsApp. It connects to a business's existing WhatsApp number through the official WhatsApp Business API and takes over routine conversations: answering questions, booking appointments, taking orders and classifying leads — 24 hours a day, in natural language and with the brand's own tone.
The product website is https://mocter.co (Spanish by default, English available at /en).

## Main capabilities

- **24/7 customer support over WhatsApp.** The assistant answers frequent questions, guides customers and keeps a configurable brand tone (friendly, formal, with or without emojis) in natural language.
- **Smart appointment scheduling.** Integrates with Google Calendar and Google Meet. The assistant offers available time slots, confirms the appointment, creates the Meet link when applicable and sends automatic reminders.
- **Orders and quotes.** Captures customer details, totals and registers orders automatically from the conversation.
- **Automatic contact classification.** Every conversation is tagged by intent and moved through a pipeline: cold lead → warm lead → hot lead → order → delivered.
- **Unified inbox.** A web dashboard shows all conversations with AI tags, priority (e.g. urgent), contact state and which assistant handled each chat. A human can take over any conversation manually at any time.
- **Multimedia delivery.** Photos, videos, catalogs and PDFs are shared automatically during conversations.

## Sectors served

Clinics and medical practices, salons and spas, consultancies and studios, real estate, schools and education, technical services, e-commerce and retail, agencies and startups, restaurants and reservations, gyms and wellness.

## Key facts

- **Data residency:** customer data is hosted on servers in Colombia, in compliance with local data protection rules. Customers keep ownership of their data.
- **Setup:** three steps — connect the WhatsApp number, train the AI with the business's services, hours, prices and tone, then start automating. Customers of the business don't need to install anything; they keep texting the same WhatsApp number.
- **Pricing:** demo requests are free and handled within 24 hours; pricing is quoted per business. There is no cost per conversation claim on the landing page.
